description.value: Sir Landon James Charters is an Indigenous-owned and operated boat charter company in Tofino, led by Captain Bert Tom, a proud member of the Tla-o-qui-aht First Nation whose ancestors have called these waters home for over 10,000 years. The company specializes in small-group tours to Meares Island's Big Tree Trail, where ancient western red cedars — some believed to be two millennia old — stand as living monuments to the Nuu-chah-nulth people's successful land protection efforts in the 1980s. For a touring cyclist in Tofino, this offers a culturally immersive side trip onto the water and into old-growth forest just a short ride from town.
